duration.text: The Chemical Engineering at China University of Mining And Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of master degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of master degree 5. Bank Statement (No less than 20000RMB) 6. Non-criminal certificate 7. Physical examination form 8. Two recommendation letters 9. Personal Statement 10. English certificate (Duolingo test, IELTS, TOEFL)

requirements.text: 1. Age: Bachelor applicants: no more than 25 years old; Master applicants: no more than 35 years old; Doctoral applicants: no more than 40 years old; 2. Good health;
